assign.outcome:
**Two CSS undos — the white rectangle inside every dark `pre`, and `--tab-fade`.** Both verified computed and by eye at 1280.

![](/framework/ai/2026-08-18/code-hairline/shot.png)

**The `code` hairline — it was never meant to reach a `pre`.** `framework.css` already resets `pre > code`, but only `padding` and `background`; the `box-shadow` fell through, so the inset ring drew around the inner `<code>` of every fenced block — light `--line` on the dark `#3f3f3f` floor. Fixed by adding `box-shadow: none` to that same reset. Inline code keeps its hairline.

**Provenance:** added by **the mastermind (Fable), 2026-08-17 22:11:30**, logged in [`mastermind-shots`](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/mastermind-shots/) ("Fixed the one open regression myself... verified computed") and [`layout-primitives`](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/layout-primitives/). It was fixing a real regression [`remeasure-diff`](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/remeasure-diff/) found at 21:20: wave 3 gave inline code `background: var(--wash)`, but `.app` **is** `--wash`, so the chip went invisible and its padding read as a naked space — `Item 's own record`, `View , Page , App`. The prescription was "border 1px solid var(--line), or drop the padding"; box-shadow was chosen because it does not take layout width. Computed style was verified on inline code only, never inside a `pre`. Uncommitted, so `git blame` says "Not Committed Yet".

**`--tab-fade` — removed, all three references.** The custom property and `mask-image` on `.tab-bar`, plus the `mask-image` repeat in the `max-width: 64em` vertical rule. `border-bottom`, `scrollbar-width: none` and `reveal()` untouched. Recorded in [`ext/tabs/doc/decisions.md`](/framework/ext/tabs/doc/decisions.md) and [`doc/overflow.md`](/framework/ext/tabs/doc/overflow.md), with a "don't re-add without asking" line in `tabs.css`.

**Left / open:**
- Tab overflow now cuts hard at both edges with no affordance but `reveal()` — that is what the mask was for (`SHELL` rendering as `ELL`, 19 findings on 7 pages). `scrollbar-width: thin` is the one-word alternative if an affordance is wanted; it was measured as weak.
- The **inline** hairline stayed, since removing it reinstates the invisible-chip regression from yesterday. It is six bordered pills per paragraph on `/framework/ext/tabs/` — worth a look; awaiting the owner's call.
